Wz_wtGHNh2tWF_-xuv5NKA.zh: 緬甸仰光自8/9迄今報告逾500人因腹瀉住院,其中至少149例快篩陽性,並有1例死亡,已有病例輸出至孟邦(Mon State)等地區,病患主要集中於仰光市中,疑感染源為受汙染之水源及街頭小吃。仰光以往罕見霍亂疫情,惟因基礎設施缺乏維護、嚴重降雨洪災,加上內戰導致醫療公衛系統脆弱,大幅加劇傳播風險。
Wz_wtGHNh2tWF_-xuv5NKA.en: In Yangon, Myanmar, more than 500 people have been hospitalised for diarrhoea since 9 August, of whom at least 149 tested positive on rapid tests, and one has died. Cases have been exported to other areas, including Mon State, and are mainly concentrated in central Yangon; contaminated water sources and street food are suspected sources of infection. Cholera outbreaks were previously rare in Yangon, but poorly maintained infrastructure, severe flooding, and a fragile health and public health system weakened by civil war have greatly increased the risk of transmission.

qIyTX4jbFMJZkgBvdms1_w.en: Rakhine State in southwestern Myanmar has recorded more than 1,000 cumulative cases and 30 deaths so far this year, exceeding last year's full-year totals for cases and deaths. The rise is mainly due to a shortage of public health and medical resources. In Ikongo district in eastern Madagascar, cases have risen, with more than 3,500 cases reported since mid-May and nearly 200 cumulative deaths this year. May recorded the most deaths, with 66, and June recorded 49. Plasmodium falciparum is the most common malaria parasite locally.

hS9fZcHflOh9C8eMm9VR6A.en: An outbreak has occurred in the Shwe Kokko area of Kayin State in southeastern Myanmar. As of 30 December 2024, over 700 cases of acute diarrhoea had been reported cumulatively, including 2 deaths. Tak Province in neighbouring Thailand reported 4 cases cumulatively. Authorities have closed border crossings and provided medical supplies to Myanmar. With the assistance of WHO and other partners, case numbers have fallen substantially.
